content: Each row is a form space. Open one to manage its forms and responses, pin it for quick access, or use the three dots to invite people, copy a shared link and save the space as a template.

comment.text: Body of the Forms onboarding tour step that highlights the first form space row; variant for users who can create spaces (others see FormsItemMember). The three dots are the row's menu button.
